name: Endemeteo
desc: An enhanced version of a Meteor. The double-ended blade flickers with both fire and lightning. Those who master its use are able to wield both elemental powers without so much as blinking.

eff.name: Firebolt Twincut
eff.desc1: Deals [7 + (Lv. x 7)] power fire and bolt damage and reduces maximum HP by [Lv. x 3]%.
eff.desc2: Deals [7 + (Lv. x 7)] power fire and bolt damage. Damage is increased by [Lv. x 5]% when there is more than one target.

eff.name: Encircling Flamewall
eff.desc1: Reduces ATK, DEF, and SPD by [Lv. x 1]% for each target hit by the attack.
eff.desc2: Boosts critical rate by [Lv. x 3]% for each target hit by the attack.

eff.name: Dancing Flashbolt
eff.desc1: Reduces cooldowns by [Lv. x 3]% when environmental mana gauge is at 50% or higher.
